entry.author: Creative New Zealand
entry.summary:
We’re inviting artists, ringatoi, organisations and communities to share feedback on the draft Te Ara Mana Tautika o ngā Toi – Equity in the Arts Policy. 

This draft sets out how Creative New Zealand will support equity (fairness) in the arts and ngā toi Māori and deliver to our statutory purpose ‘to encourage, promote and support the arts in New Zealand for the benefit of all New Zealanders’. 

We need your whakaaro to help shape the final version of the policy and ensure it reflects the realities and aspirations of artists and communities across Aotearoa New Zealand. 

Read more: https://creativenz.govt.nz/equityinthearts
